description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractUpdater' used as a superclass for subscription management components in a pub/sub system within an Akka actor framework. It handles subscription requests, acknowledgments, updates to distributed data, and cluster members management, utilizing metrics and logging facilities.

classes.name: AbstractUpdater
classes.description: An abstract class for managing subscription updates and data replication in a distributed pub/sub system using Akka actors.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Sets up message handling for various subscription, cluster, and data update messages.

methods.name: ddataOpSuccess
methods.description: Abstract method to handle successful distributed data updates.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to process subscription requests.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to process unsubscription requests.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Abstract method triggered on each clock tick to perform periodic updates.

methods.name: updateFailure
methods.description: Handles failure of distributed data update attempts, logging the error and flagging that local subscriptions have changed.

methods.name: forceUpdate
methods.description: Determines if the next data update should be a forced (non-regular) update based on probability.

methods.name: enqueueRequest
methods.description: Enqueues subscription requests for later processing, updating consistency and acknowledgment queues.

methods.name: getSeqNr
methods.description: Returns the last assigned sequence number for acknowledgment messages.

methods.name: exportAwaitSubAck
methods.description: Exports accumulated acknowledgment messages up to a given sequence number for processing.

methods.name: moveAwaitUpdateToAwaitAcknowledge
methods.description: Transfers pending update requests to acknowledgment waiting queue upon starting a distributed data write.

methods.name: handleDDataWriteResult
methods.description: Creates a callback function to handle the result of a distributed data write operation.

methods.name: logUnhandled
methods.description: Logs unexpected or unhandled messages.

methods.name: terminated
methods.description: Handles actor termination events.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Handles requests to remove a subscriber from the system.

methods.name: doRemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Performs the actual removal of a subscriber, unwatching it from the actor context.

methods.name: upgradeWriteConsistency
methods.description: Upgrades the write consistency if a more global level is requested.

methods.name: isMoreConsistent
methods.description: Compares two write consistency levels to determine if one is more globally consistent than the other.

methods.name: rank
methods.description: Calculates a numerical rank representing the level of write consistency.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Inner abstract class representing subscription-related requests with common properties.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Represents a subscription request with optional filtering for incoming messages.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Represents an unsubscription request.

methods.name: RemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Request to remove a subscriber, with extra info for acknowledgment label declarations.

methods.name: SubAck
methods.description: Acknowledgment object for subscription request processing.

methods.name: Clock
methods.description: Enumeration representing periodic clock tick events for actor scheduling.

methods.name: DeclareAckLabels
methods.description: Request message to declare acknowledgment labels for a subscriber.

methods.name: DDataOpSuccess
methods.description: Inner class to encapsulate successful distributed data operations.
